alternate_names: Gurudwara Shri Guru Gobind Singh Ji, Ellenabad

history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE — SIKH GURDWARA; keep-or-drop decision needed. The Haryana Tourism-listed 'Gurudwara Guru Gobind Singh' associated with the tenth Guru, Guru Gobind Singh (who is said to have stayed here for a night), is at Ellenabad, SIRSA district — the CSV town 'Hisar' is wrong and should be corrected (no gurdwara of this name is documented in Hisar city). The complex is spread over 8 acres with a sarovar/tank (separate enclosure for ladies), a small museum and a library, per Haryana Tourism. Note: a different, similarly named shrine — 'Gurudwara Guru Gobind Singh, Chormar Khera (Tehsil Dabwali)' — is also listed by the Divisional Commissioner, Hisar, as a Sirsa-district religious site, so the exact referent should be verified; the Ellenabad shrine is documented here as the most prominent one.

name: Gurudwara Guru Gobind Singh
town_description: Ellenabad is a town in Sirsa district in northwestern Haryana, close to the Rajasthan border. It is best known for the historical Gurudwara Guru Gobind Singh, associated with a visit by the tenth Sikh Guru.

travel.airport: Nearest major airport: Chandigarh International Airport (approx. 225 km)
travel.road: On SH-23; connected by road to Sirsa (approx. 40 km) and Hisar (approx. 130 km)

visitor_information.opening_hours: Not documented; gurdwaras typically open from early morning (Amrit Vela) to late evening
